newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Danareksa to acquire Soedarpo.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Danareksa to acquire Soedarpo.

text.p: Indonesian financial firm PT Danareksa said on Monday it planned to acquire a 51 percent stake in small-sized pharmaceutical supplies distributor PT NVPD Soedarpo Corporation.
"The firm (Danareksa) intends to own 6,961,500 shares or around a 51 percent stake in the targetted firm (Soedarpo)," Danareksa said in an announcement.
Danareksa said it already had 450 Soedarpo shares and that it still needed 6,961,050 shares to reach the 51 percent ownership mark.
Danareksa said the purchase was expected to be done at 2,275 rupiah per share, which was 25 rupiah above the highest price of Soedarpo shares within 90 days before the announcement.
Bank BDNI said in the announcement that Danareksa had sufficient funds to complete the acquisition.
The announcement did not give further details.
